from units.compat.mock import patch

from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
from .icx_module import TestICXModule


class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
    module = icx_logging

    def setUp(self):
        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
        self.get_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
        self.get_config = self.get_patch.start()
        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
        self.get_config.return_value = ('logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514\\n'
                                        'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514\\n'
                                        'logging facility local0\\nlogging console\\n'
                                        'logging buffered\\nno logging buffered debugging\\n'
                                        'logging persistence\\nlogging enable rfc5424')

    def tearDown(self):
        self.get_patch.stop()
        self.load_patch.stop()
        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()

    def test_aggregate_idempotent(self):
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514),
            dict(facility='local0'),
            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'),
            dict(dest='console')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_aggregate_changes(self):
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::2', udp_port=5514),
            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', state='absent'),
            dict(facility='local1'),
            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'),
            dict(dest='console', state='absent'),
            dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::2 udp-port 5514',
            'no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
            'logging facility local1', 'logging buffered debugging',
            'no logging console', 'no logging enable rfc5424'])

    def test_absent_and_global(self):
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'),
            dict(facility='local0', state='absent'),
            dict(dest='on', state='absent'),
            dict(dest='persistence', state='absent')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
            'no logging facility', 'no logging on', 'no logging persistence'])

    def test_check_mode(self):
        set_module_args(dict(dest='console', state='absent', _ansible_check_mode=True))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging console'])
        self.load_config.assert_not_called()

    def test_required(self):
        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered'))
        self.execute_module(failed=True)
